title: Geologic map of the Woodford 15-minute quadrangle 1:62500 (Pond Branch; Swansea; Harleys Millpond; North 1:24000), cross section and explanation [these quadrangles are superseded -- Harleys Millpond, Pond Branch]
citation: Kite, L.E., 1984, Geologic map of the Woodford 15-minute quadrangle 1:62500 (Pond Branch; Swansea; Harleys Millpond; North 1:24000), cross section and explanation: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-40, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
OFR-40 (Kite 1984; digital plates 2009): Woodford 15-minute quadrangle as four 7.5-minute plates (Pond Branch, Swansea, Harleys Millpond, North) and a cross-section plate (page 5, OCR unreadable). Units from the plate explanations; no descriptions or thicknesses. SCGS drill-hole labels, Cooke (1936) and Pooser (1965) locality numbers and McKissick Museum localities appear on the map faces; hole labels are queued for an image re-read. SUBSURFACE: none recorded in this pass.
OFR-40 (Kite 1984; digital plates 2009): Woodford 15-minute quadrangle as four 7.5-minute plates (Pond Branch, Swansea, Harleys Millpond, North) and a cross-section plate (page 5, OCR unreadable). Units from the plate explanations; no descriptions or thicknesses. SCGS drill-hole labels, Cooke (1936) and Pooser (1965) locality numbers and McKissick Museum localities appear on the map faces; hole labels are queued for an image re-read. SUBSURFACE: none recorded in this pass. Re-read of pages 1-4 (2026-11-17): SCGS hole labels (2-, 9-, 32-, 38-) and Cooke/Pooser/McKissick locality labels read on 72 dpi tiles; three hole labels with doubtful prefixes are marked unclear.
